digest.component_or_area: pytest CI test execution / pytest-timeout integration
propositions: Per-test hang budget lowered from 300s to 20s sits inside the band of legitimate whole-tree-scan test costs (18.7-29.93s measured on covered CI legs with coverage overhead), causing worker crashes under timeout_method=thread

timeout_method=thread expresses budget expiry as os._exit(1) process kill rather than pytest.fail() verdict, so xdist workers die with zero Failed: Timeout lines and NEVER report clean timeout violations

Workflow-provenance defect prevents config-only patchset fixes from exercising themselves: Verified gate executes _build-and-test.yml from trusted main not the patchset, so main's stale CLI --timeout=20 overrides a patchset's ini timeout=300 restore via pytest-timeout precedence CLI > INI

Dead xdist workers under --dist loadgroup re-dispatch their pending test queue to respawned workers that crash on the same item up to numprocesses*4 retries, burning toward the 60-minute job timeout ceiling instead of failing fast

Budget restore to 300s in ini and both shared-tier lanes' explicit flags, combined with headroom contract tests asserting >= 2x measured worst-case and <= 600s, prevents regression to sub-budget values
